posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
We only play with three heroes but one of the msot fun games we had was TLT, Adept, and Unity (in that order) which led to Unity just wrecking whomever it was we were fighting thanks to TLT letting her get a large handful of cards and the Adept playing Inventive Preparation on the first or second round to let her chuck out pretty much all of her army :D.

Another fun one was Legacy, Ra, and...someone (probably doesn't really matter who) in Insula Primalis, versus Akash'Bhuta. Let the Obsidian Fields stay out, get everyone to zap stuff, and in between doing that get out Flesh of the Sun God and wait for the volcano - much fun :D.

I like Expat, AZ, Fixer, Parse a lot.

I order them Parse/Expat/Fixer/AZ most of the time.

posts.name: waedens
posts.cooked: We like GrandaPa Legacy, Santa Guise, Omnitron-X and Knife Rogue Agent. Each one of these cards has a power that makes other players do something out of turn. Even if you just had your turn you can't leave the table as you might be needed to play a card from the top or bottom of your deck, or the pile of cards in front of you or you might be using a power out of turn. If you need a 5th just add The Adept to the game.

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
I like thematic teamups.

One of my favorites is Ra/Fanatic(redemer)/AbZero. "Judgments by Fire and Ice" is my nickname for it. 

Or you could go Haka(of knowledge)/Scholar/Legacy(granpda)/Fixer for a team of "the Elders"

Or maybe Tachyon/Unity/Parse/OmnitronX as a science-squad teamup.

How about Tempest/Sky/Nightmist/Fanatic as the "inhumans" (sorry marvel).

Bunker/AbZero/Legacy/Sentinels (adamant) as the "government watchdogs"

Wraith/KNYFE/Fixer (Dark Watch)/Expat as a type of X-force covert-ops group.

Take OmnitronX/ChronoRanger + anyone else and you get an instant timetravel storyline.

Nightmist/Ra/Argent Adept/Captain Cosmic gets you a "masters of magic" feel.

Setback/Guise/Unity/Scholar(?) is a fun pairing to me storywise because they all are funloving laid back kinda characters that would get into some fun shenanigans together.

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Sometimes, I just feel like dealing a lot of quick, steady damage:

 

Legacy, Mr. Fixer, Tempest, Ra, Fanatic/Haka

 

I'll take Haka if I'm afraid of a lot of damage taken and want to have a chance to Ground Pound. I'll take Fanatic if I just want to pile on more, quick damage. For single-target villains (Spite, Mad Bomber Blade) or if I don't want to hit everyone (Dreamer) I'll sub out Tempest. If I'm feeling sassy, I'll sub in Expatriette.
